fact: The ground trembled as the party approached Themberchaud's lair.
source_quote: The ground trembled before they arrived
subject: ground tremor

fact: Themberchaud is a massive red dragon with scales the color of cooling lava and bright yellow eyes.
source_quote: His scales were the color of cooling lava, and his bright yellow eyes gleamed in the shadows
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud is well-fed and has the appearance of a predator who has not hunted in a very long time.
source_quote: clearly well-fed, carrying the unmistakable look of a predator who had not hunted in a very long time
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud announces himself by joking that the party is not surfacers for dinner.
source_quote: He announced himself with the joke, "You didn't say I was having surfacers for dinner tonight."
subject: Themberchaud's introduction

fact: The priests introduce Themberchaud as the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh and Father of Flame.
source_quote: The priests introduced him with great reverence as Themberchaud, the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh, Father of Flame
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud dismisses the Duergar priests from his presence.
source_quote: Themberchaud dismissed the priests
subject: priests dismissed

fact: The Duergar priests appear visibly uncomfortable at being left alone with the strangers.
source_quote: who were visibly uncomfortable at leaving him alone with strangers
subject: Duergar priests

fact: Themberchaud leads the party into his private lair.
source_quote: and led the party into his private lair
subject: lair entry

fact: Themberchaud threatens to turn anyone invisible to ash.
source_quote: There he threatened to turn anyone invisible to ash
subject: anti-invisibility threat

fact: Themberchaud thrashes his wings inside the lair.
source_quote: thrashed his wings about
subject: wing thrashing

fact: Themberchaud breathes fire in every direction inside the lair.
source_quote: breathed fire in every direction
subject: fire breathing

fact: Themberchaud settles onto a mountain of gold in his lair.
source_quote: before settling onto a mountain of gold
subject: landing on gold

fact: Themberchaud dismisses Gyrgum's devotion to Bahamut with the word "Next!"
source_quote: He dismissed Gyrgum's devotion to Bahamut with a curt "Next!"
subject: interrogation of Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum states that he serves Bahamut, the platinum dragon.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "I serve Bahamut, the platinum dragon."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Themberchaud expresses mild disdain for Zalthir's brass dragonborn heritage.
source_quote: He expressed mild disdain for Zalthir's brass dragonborn heritage
subject: interrogation of Zalthir

fact: Themberchaud refers to Zalthir as an inferior Dragonborn.
source_quote: Themberchaud calls Zalthir "an inferior Dragonborn, if ever there was one."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud shows approval for Daz's Drow origins and capacity for secrecy.
source_quote: He showed a flicker of approval for Daz's Drow origins, from Menzoberranzan, and his capacity for secrecy
subject: interrogation of Daz

fact: Daz confirms he is from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Daz confirms he is from Menzoberranzan
subject: Daz

fact: Themberchaud comments that Daz is capable of conspiracies and secrecy.
source_quote: "At least they bring me someone who is capable of conspiracies and secrecy."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Thorin identifies himself as Thorin Giantfriend.
source_quote: "My name is Thorin Giantfriend
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin states he was a foundling who grew up amongst giants.
source_quote: and I was a foundling and grew up amongst giants...
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin states that he likes to hit things over the head.
source_quote: but I like to hit things over the head."
subject: Thorin

fact: Themberchaud seems amused by Thorin's explanation of his background.
source_quote: When Thorin explained that he had simply been minding his own business before waking up in a jail cell surrounded by Drow and strangers, the dragon seemed almost amused.
subject: interrogation of Thorin

fact: Themberchaud is delighted that the party has nobody to be blackmailed.
source_quote: He was delighted that the party had "nobody to be blackmailed."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud declares the party his personal agents without waiting for formal agreement.
source_quote: Without waiting for the party to formally agree, Themberchaud declared them his personal agents
subject: agent declaration

fact: Themberchaud states that being his agents grants the party his protection.
source_quote: And by being my agents, you will gain my protection.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud summons his liaison, Gartokkar.
source_quote: summoned his liaison Gartokkar
subject: Gartokkar summons

fact: Gartokkar acts as the liaison for the party.
source_quote: Gartokkar to act as their liaison
subject: Gartokkar

fact: Themberchaud presents each member of the party with a golden badge bearing his own profile.
source_quote: presented each of them with a golden badge bearing his own profile
subject: badge distribution

fact: The badges given by Themberchaud are made of real gold.
source_quote: Daz confirms the badge is real gold
subject: golden badge

fact: The badges bear Themberchaud's profile.
source_quote: bearing his own profile
subject: golden badge

fact: The party's first mission is to do whatever the Keepers ask but report back to Themberchaud first.
source_quote: Their first mission is to do whatever the Keepers ask but report back to Themberchaud first
subject: first mission

fact: Thorin suggests forming their own faction.
source_quote: Thorin: "I think we need to form our own faction."
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin suggests tipping Themberchaud off about a new dragon in training.
source_quote: Thorin suggests tipping the dragon off that the Duergar have "a new dragon in training."
subject: new dragon rumor

fact: The Duergar prefer each people to keep to its own place.
source_quote: The Duergar prefer each people to keep to its own place
subject: Duergar

fact: The Duergar value rule-following and directness.
source_quote: value rule-following and directness
subject: Duergar

fact: The Duergar lack a sense of humor.
source_quote: "lack a sense of humor"
subject: Duergar

fact: The party travels into Duergar territory on its permit.
source_quote: The party travels on its permit into Duergar territory
subject: Duergar territory
